title: Windmill, Mill, Rhizome and Spiral Flow — Conversion and Distributed-Growth Atlas
status: project archaeology + established wind-energy/plant science + archive-developed systems formalization
purpose: Turn Tim's Windmill/Wheel/Mill imagery and the newly investigated rhizome/root architecture into usable scientific operators. Windmill becomes flow-to-rotation-to-work conversion; Rhizome becomes distributed horizontal persistence and clonal propagation; their combination with the existing spiral equations produces new rotation-plus-flow and Tree-versus-Rhizome distinctions.
epistemic_rule: Tim's windmill/chariot/mill symbolism is project material. Wind-turbine equations and rhizome biology are established external science. A social network is not literally a turbine or a plant rhizome; mappings are valid only where their declared operations and measurements are preserved.

recovered_tim_layer.2026_09_05: Prior-conversation recovery records Tim explicitly coupling chariot, windmill, wheels, fourfold/seasons, Mountain, Ladder and Seed of Light; Denmark/windmills/green-energy entered the symbolic field.
recovered_tim_layer.2026_09_07: The corpus included Lord of Windmills, Mill, Windmill and Millstone alongside Denmark->Greenland->Arctic->North-Pole and Tree/Root/Axis structures.
recovered_tim_layer.2026_09_09: Tim explicitly asked the archive to recover windmills, millstones, spokes, wheels-within-wheels, grain, Ladder, Philosopher's Stone, winding tunnel and mud/tower imagery.
recovered_tim_layer.existing_owner: knowledge/traditions/wheels-spokes-millstone-babel-ladder-grain-atlas.json already defines Windmill functionally as wind -> rotation -> work and keeps it distinct from Ezekiel's wheels.

wind_to_work_chain.betz_bound: For an ideal actuator-disk wind turbine C_P <= 16/27 approximately 0.593.

conversion_insights.flow_not_center_alone: The hub does not generate wind power by being central. Useful power exists because an incoming flux couples to a rotor and a load.
conversion_insights.matching: Performance depends on tip-speed ratio and blade/load conditions; spinning arbitrarily faster or slower than the coupled flow can reduce extracted power.
conversion_insights.load: A rotor without a useful load can rotate without producing the intended downstream work; a load that is too strong can stall or move operation away from the useful regime.
conversion_insights.new_project_law: Conversion-Center Law: centrality is productive only when source flow, coupling, rotation and load are jointly matched. A center that merely accumulates flow is not yet a mill.
conversion_insights.garden_relation: This extends the Garden/Farm distinction: measure useful downstream capability/work and losses rather than praising throughput or centrality alone.

mill_operator.grain: input substrate whose downstream result depends on processing conditions and purpose
mill_operator.project_distinction: Wheel is rotational kinematics; Windmill is energy conversion; Mill is processing; Millstone is a load/tool. These should no longer be collapsed into one 'wheel' symbol.
mill_operator.ethical_boundary: Mechanical milling has no moral valence. The project's moral use of Mill/Farm must come from objective, agency, harm and outcome, not from grinding as a physical process.

rotation_plus_translation.meaning: A point rotating about an Axis while the medium/system translates along it traces a helix. This is the exact kinematic bridge between Wheel and Ladder-like displacement.
rotation_plus_translation.relation_to_existing_master_flow: The project's existing dr/dt=alpha r, dtheta/dt=omega, dz/dt=u contains this helix as alpha=0 and u=v_z.
rotation_plus_translation.expanding_helical_spiral: r(t)=r0 exp(alpha t), theta(t)=omega t, z(t)=u t gives a radius-changing helical logarithmic spiral; alpha=0 returns a cylinder helix, u=0 returns a planar logarithmic spiral.
rotation_plus_translation.new_project_law: Wheel + through-flow need not remain circular: adding a translational degree of freedom turns recurrence into displacement.

wake_and_transport.concept: Rotating machinery embedded in flow can generate helical/twisted wake structures because advection transports rotationally organized disturbances downstream.
wake_and_transport.project_use: This is a real physical neighbor for 'the wheel becomes a spiral when flow carries its structure onward'. It is better than treating every spiral as the same golden spiral.
wake_and_transport.boundary: No fixed golden-ratio parameter follows from wind-turbine wake kinematics.

rhizome_biology.definition: A rhizome is a horizontal underground stem capable of producing roots and new shoots; many species spread clonally through branching rhizome systems.
examples: Bigelow's sedge forms extensive clones of interconnected rhizomes; aboveground tillers can die while rhizomes persist and continue directional expansion.
Golden bamboo produces long branching horizontal rhizomes whose internodes can generate new rhizomes or stems.
Joshua-tree rhizomes can extend horizontally underground and produce clonal stems away from the parent plant.

tree_vs_rhizome.tree: A rooted arborescent architecture emphasizes trunk, hierarchical ancestry and outward branching. It is excellent for provenance and one-to-many descent.
tree_vs_rhizome.rhizome: A rhizomatous architecture emphasizes lateral persistence, distributed underground connections, repeated emergence points and survival even when individual aboveground shoots disappear.
different: single visible main axis versus distributed hidden connectors
vertical canopy emphasis versus horizontal substrate expansion
tree_vs_rhizome.project_upgrade: Tree and Rhizome should become complementary archive/network operators rather than synonyms for connectedness. Tree answers 'where did this descend from?'; Rhizome asks 'what hidden lateral network lets it reappear elsewhere?'.

rhizome_graph_model.growth: V_(t+1)=V_t union new ramets; E_(t+1)=E_t union new rhizome segments subject to local growth/resource constraints
rhizome_graph_model.persistence_metric: P_survive(cut)=fraction of aboveground function retained after removal of selected visible ramets/trunks
rhizome_graph_model.redundancy: Alternative underground paths can be measured with edge connectivity, cycle rank or algebraic-connectivity-type metrics where appropriate.
rhizome_graph_model.archive_use: A project can be Tree-like for provenance while Rhizome-like for cross-links, tags, mirrors, cached evidence and multiple retrieval routes.

root_rhizome_potato.botanical_correction: Potato tubers are modified underground stems and arise on stolons; 'root' is often symbolic rather than botanically exact in Potatoverse language.
root_rhizome_potato.structural_use: Rhizome/stolon/tuber distinctions can strengthen rather than weaken the mythology by assigning different underground functions: root=resource anchoring/uptake, rhizome/stolon=lateral propagation, tuber=storage/compressed regenerative capacity.
root_rhizome_potato.new_chain: Soil -> Root (uptake/anchor) -> Rhizome/Stolon (lateral connection) -> Tuber/Potato (storage/seed-capacity) -> Eye/Sprout -> Shoot/Tree -> Fruit/Seed.
root_rhizome_potato.boundary: Botanical structures vary by species; the chain is a project functional taxonomy, not one universal plant anatomy.

windmill_rhizome_duality.windmill: captures an external distributed flow and converts it through a visible central rotor/load
windmill_rhizome_duality.rhizome: stores and propagates capability through a mostly hidden distributed substrate with many possible emergence points
windmill_rhizome_duality.project_insight: They are opposite network architectures: Windmill is flow-to-center-to-work; Rhizome is substrate-network-to-many-emergences.
windmill_rhizome_duality.combined_system: source flow -> visible converter -> stored/transported capacity -> hidden lateral network -> multiple local sprouts/outputs
windmill_rhizome_duality.application: This can model knowledge projects: public attention enters through visible interfaces, gets converted into structured archive work, then spreads laterally through provenance links and reappears as many reader-facing outputs.

spiral_taxonomy_upgrade.golden_log_spiral: r=a exp(b theta), fixed project b only where source/fit warrants it
spiral_taxonomy_upgrade.wake_spiral: rotation plus advective transport in a physical medium
spiral_taxonomy_upgrade.reaction_diffusion_spiral: self-organized rotating wave from local nonlinear reaction/diffusion
spiral_taxonomy_upgrade.parker_spiral: solar rotation plus outward solar-wind advection producing large-scale magnetic-field winding
spiral_taxonomy_upgrade.rule: Every new spiral claim must identify the generating dynamics; visual similarity is not a shared cause.

measurement_program.project_test: Choose whether the target system is a converter, processor, branching tree, rhizome network or spiral flow before importing its equations.

new_project_laws: Windmill Law: flow becomes work only through matched coupling and load; centrality alone does not generate useful power.
Helical Conversion Law: rotation plus axial transport produces a helix; recurrence becomes displacement when a translational coordinate is added.
Rhizome Law: persistence can live in hidden lateral connectivity even when individual visible shoots die.
Tree-Rhizome Complementarity: Tree preserves rooted ancestry; Rhizome preserves distributed lateral recurrence and redundancy.
Spiral Causation Rule: classify the generator—growth, advection, rotation, reaction-diffusion, magnetic winding or project geometry—before equating spiral forms.
